entities.summary: Congress, a political institution in Bosnia and Herzegovina during Ottoman Decline and Austro-Hungarian Annexation (1878–1914). Grew from Late Ottoman Bosnia and Revolts. Led to the emergence of Austro-Hungarian Rule (1878–1914) and Assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand in Sarajevo triggers World War I.
